career_ladder.note: Panchayat Secretary Grade-V and allied village/ward secretariat functionaries are grassroots administrative appointments governed by the Andhra Pradesh Panchayat Subordinate Service Rules and municipal service rules. Functionaries serve a 2-year mandatory probation period at a consolidated stipend, after which they are regularized into regular time scales upon passing departmental tests (Panchayat Subordinate Service tests and Accounts Test for Subordinate Officers).

exam_scheme.note: Recruitment is conducted through an offline objective OMR-based Written Examination comprising 150 multiple choice questions for 150 marks over 150 minutes. Penalty of 0.25 (1/4th) mark applies for every incorrect answer. Shortlisted candidates are called for Certificate Verification in a 1:2 ratio based on district-wise merit lists.

financial_package.note: Functionaries serve a mandatory 2-year probation during which they receive a consolidated honorarium of ₹15,000 per month (as prescribed under G.O.Ms.No.110 PR&RD Dept dated 19.07.2019). Following successful completion of probation and clearing departmental tests, employees are regularized into Andhra Pradesh Revised Pay Scales 2022 (RPS 2022 / 11th PRC) Scale 4 (₹22,460 - ₹72,810) vide G.O.Ms.No.114 Finance (PC-TA) Dept dated 28.06.2022.
financial_package.pay_source_label: G.O.Ms.No.114 Finance (PC-TA) Dept dt 28.06.2022 read with G.O.Ms.No.110 PR&RD Dept
financial_package.estimate_note: Estimated on regularized AP PRC 2022 Scale 4 entry basic pay of ₹22,460 with standardized 58% Dearness Allowance plus HRA (8% to 16% depending on village/mandal/district category); in-hand calculation deducts 10% CPS/NPS, APGLI/GIS, and Professional Tax (₹200). Initial 2-year probation receives consolidated stipend of ₹15,000/month.
official_perks: House Rent Allowance (HRA) as per AP PRC 2022 categorization (8% for rural mandals up to 16% for urban areas)
Contributory Pension Scheme (CPS) / Andhra Pradesh Guaranteed Pension Scheme (APGPS) upon regularization
Andhra Pradesh Employees Health Scheme (EHS) cashless medical coverage for employee and family
Earned leave, half-pay leave, and maternity leave benefits as per AP State Fundamental Rules
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) within Andhra Pradesh as per state government entitlements
